title: Daytona, which is building cloud infrastructure for AI agents, raised a $60M Series B led by FirstMark at a $1B valuation, bringing its total funding to $91M (Jeremy Kahn/Fortune)
summary: Jeremy Kahn / Fortune: Daytona, which is building cloud infrastructure for AI agents, raised a $60M Series B led by FirstMark at a $1B valuation, bringing its total funding to $91M — AI agents need somewhere to work—and Ivan Burazin thinks the existing cloud providers aren't the right answer.
